definition: a unit of money formerly used in France and other countries, and still used in Switzerland

collocations.example: The Swiss franc remained strong against the euro last year.
France used the French franc before switching to the euro.

definition: a social organization for male students at an American college or university

collocations.example: He joined a fraternity during his first year of college.
The fraternity house stood near the edge of the campus.

definition: intended to deceive people in a dishonest and illegal way

collocations.example: He was arrested for filing a fraudulent insurance claim.
The bank flagged several fraudulent transactions on her account.

definition: a picture painted onto wet plaster on a wall or ceiling

collocations.example: The church ceiling features a beautiful Renaissance fresco.
Experts spent years working to restore the faded fresco.

definition: producing good or useful results

collocations.example: We had a long and fruitful discussion about the project.
Their fruitful partnership produced several successful new products.

definition: a person who has escaped or is hiding, especially from the police or the law

collocations.example: The bank robber became a fugitive from justice.
It is a crime to knowingly harbor a fugitive.

definition: a state of feeling unhappy, discouraged, or without energy

collocations.example: She was in a funk after losing her job.

definition: a tube that is wide at the top and narrow at the bottom, used for pouring liquids into a container

definition: an enclosed container in which material is heated to a very high temperature, used for melting metal or heating a building

definition: a long narrow cut or line made in the ground, especially by a plow for planting seeds

definition: a mass of short, soft, fine hairs or fibers

definition: the triangular upper part of a wall at the end of a building, where it meets the sloping roof

A small window sat high on the gable end.

definition: a small tool or device that does something useful

collocations.example: This handy gadget peels potatoes in just a few seconds.
He loves buying the latest electronic gadget on sale.

definition: the kitchen on a ship or aircraft

definition: to shock or urge someone into taking action

definition: a type of very high-energy radiation given off by some radioactive substances

definition: a member of an organized group of violent criminals

He starred in a classic gangster movie about the mob.

definition: relating to the stomach

definition: relating to the stomach and the intestines

definition: the deliberate killing of a large group of people from a particular nation or ethnic group

definition: a very small living thing that can cause disease

definition: a part of a city, often poor, where people of a particular group live separately from others

definition: to cover something with a thin layer of gold

definition: to obtain information slowly and with difficulty, often from various sources

definition: a feeling of great delight or joy

definition: a faint or unsteady light

definition: a simple type of sugar that provides energy for the body

Regular exercise can help lower high glucose levels.

definition: a deep narrow valley with steep rocky sides, usually with a river running through it

They rafted through the narrow river gorge at dawn.

definition: the way in which an organization or country is managed and controlled

The report called for good governance of public funds.

definition: the degree to which the ground or a road slopes; a slope

definition: words or drawings painted or sprayed on walls and other surfaces in public places

definition: relating to grammar, or following the rules of grammar correctly

The teacher explained the grammatical structure of the sentence.

definition: to try hard to deal with or understand a difficult problem

definition: in a very serious way, or to a serious degree

definition: a sauce made from the juices of cooked meat, served with food

She served the turkey with rich homemade gravy.

definition: a small bomb that is thrown by hand or fired from a gun

definition: the area of the body where the top of the legs meets the front of the body

collocations.example: The athlete pulled up with a painful groin injury.
He was struck hard in the groin area.

definition: to search for something using your hands because you cannot see

definition: extremely ugly or strange in a way that is shocking or unpleasant

definition: an outward appearance or form that hides the true nature of something

The old idea has now returned in a new guise.

definition: a common seabird with gray or white feathers and a loud cry

collocations.example: A lone sea gull flew low over the waves.
A flock of gulls followed the small fishing boat.

definition: a small narrow channel or valley cut into the ground by running water

collocations.example: Heavy rain carved a deep gully across the field.

definition: a person who is an expert on a particular subject and whose advice others follow

collocations.example: She became a leading management guru after her book succeeded.
Investors eagerly followed the advice of the financial guru.

definition: to flow out suddenly and in large quantities

Blood gushed from the deep wound on his leg.

definition: a sudden strong rush of wind

definition: done regularly or repeatedly, often as a habit

collocations.example: Nobody believed him because he was a habitual liar.

definition: a medical condition in which there is serious bleeding, especially inside the body

Surgeons worked quickly to stop the internal haemorrhage.

definition: a typical feature or quality by which something or someone is recognized

collocations.example: Attention to detail is the hallmark of her work.

definition: a small village, especially one without a church

definition: to put metal rings connected by a chain around a person's wrists to prevent movement

definition: strong and able to survive difficult or cold conditions

collocations.example: These hardy plants can survive the harshest winters.
Only a few hardy souls swam in the icy lake.

definition: relating to the way musical notes are combined to produce a pleasing sound

collocations.example: The song's rich harmonic structure impressed the music critics.
He studied the harmonic progression of the classical piece.

definition: to make different things consistent or able to work well together

definition: a large musical instrument with many strings that are played with the fingers

collocations.example: She learned to play the harp as a child.

definition: a situation that is annoying because it is difficult or causes trouble

collocations.example: Returning the faulty product turned into a real hassle.

definition: a situation in which there is a lot of damage, destruction, or confusion

Heavy snow played havoc with the morning train service.

definition: air that is difficult to see through because of heat, dust, or smoke

collocations.example: A heat haze shimmered above the long desert road.
A thick haze of smoke hung over the city.

definition: a powerful light at the front of a vehicle

collocations.example: She turned on the headlights as darkness quickly fell.

definition: having a strong effect that makes you feel excited or slightly dizzy

collocations.example: Success gave her a heady mix of pride and joy.
They recalled the heady days of the early campaign.

definition: the floor of a fireplace and the area directly in front of it

collocations.example: A log fire crackled in the open hearth.
The cat slept peacefully by the warm hearth.

definition: very busy and full of activity, often in a way that is stressful

collocations.example: She has a hectic schedule packed with daily meetings.

definition: large in amount, especially of money

He spent a hefty sum on the new equipment.

definition: the wheel or handle used to steer a ship or boat

collocations.example: The captain stood at the helm during the fierce storm.
A young sailor took the helm as they left port.

definition: a large bird with long legs and a long neck that lives near water

collocations.example: A gray heron stood motionless at the water's edge.
A night heron hunted quietly along the dark riverbank.

definition: a long thin silver sea fish that is used for food

collocations.example: They smoked the fresh herring over an open fire.
Fishermen caught a large shoal of herring at dawn.

definition: extremely ugly or unpleasant

collocations.example: The battlefield was a truly hideous sight after dawn.
The jury was shocked by such a hideous crime.

definition: extremely funny

collocations.example: He told an absolutely hilarious story about his holiday.
She shared a hilarious story about her first job.

definition: located at the back, especially of an animal's body

collocations.example: The dog stood up on its hind legs to beg.

definition: a person, especially in the 1960s, who rejected normal society and believed in peace and love

collocations.example: Her uncle was an ageing hippy who loved folk music.

definition: relating to people from Spanish-speaking countries, especially those of Latin American origin living in the United States

definition: until now or until the particular time being talked about

collocations.example: The study revealed a hitherto unknown species of frog.

definition: a structure in which bees live, either natural or made by people

collocations.example: The beekeeper carefully opened the wooden bee hive.

definition: to collect and store large amounts of something, often secretly

collocations.example: People began to hoard food before the storm hit.

definition: having a rough, harsh voice, for example because of a sore throat or shouting

collocations.example: She spoke in a hoarse voice after her cold.

definition: a pig, especially a large one raised for its meat

collocations.example: The farmer raises hundreds of hogs on his land.

definition: something said or done to show respect for someone or something

definition: the hard part of the foot of animals such as horses, cows, and deer

definition: a large ring made of metal, plastic, or wood

collocations.example: He practiced throwing the ball through the basketball hoop.
The children took turns spinning the plastic hula hoop.

definition: a short loud sound, such as the cry of an owl or the sound of a car horn

definition: a machine that cleans floors by sucking up dirt; a vacuum cleaner

definition: a large group or crowd of people, often moving in a disorganized way

definition: a special hospital or home that cares for people who are dying

collocations.example: The hospice provides gentle care for terminally ill patients.

definition: a place that provides cheap accommodation, especially for young travelers or students

collocations.example: They spent the night at a cheap youth hostel.

definition: the quality of not being too proud and not thinking you are better than others

collocations.example: She accepted the award with genuine humility and grace.
A good leader should show humility toward the team.

definition: a rounded raised part, such as the one on a camel's back

definition: to make someone move quickly, often by pushing them

definition: operated by the pressure of liquid, especially water or oil

definition: a medical condition in which the blood pressure is too high

definition: the behavior of pretending to have moral standards or beliefs that you do not really have

definition: a person who pretends to have moral standards or beliefs that they do not really have

collocations.example: Everyone soon realized that he was a complete hypocrite.

definition: a very large mass of ice floating in the sea

collocations.example: The ship narrowly avoided a huge iceberg in the fog.

definition: a sweet mixture of sugar and liquid used to cover and decorate cakes

collocations.example: She spread smooth chocolate icing over the birthday cake.

definition: a group of words whose meaning is different from the meanings of the individual words

collocations.example: The phrase 'kick the bucket' is a common idiom.

definition: not allowed by law or by social rules

collocations.example: Police seized a large quantity of illicit drugs.

definition: perfectly clean, tidy, or without any mistakes

collocations.example: The used car was still in immaculate condition.

definition: to pass on information, knowledge, or a quality to someone or something

collocations.example: A good teacher can impart knowledge in simple ways.

definition: perfect, with no faults or mistakes
